name: The ICU Survival Book (Paperback)
seoTitle: The ICU Survival Book for New ICU Nurses
metaDescription: The ICU Survival Book is a thoughtful gift for a nurse starting out in critical care, or a student who has set their sights on the ICU.
summary: A book aimed at getting through the steep early days in the ICU. A thoughtful gift for a nurse just starting in critical care.
whyItWorks: Starting in the ICU is a lot. The drips, the alarms, the families, and the speed of change can make the first months feel overwhelming, even for nurses with floor experience. A book that is framed around surviving that transition speaks directly to what a new critical care nurse is going through, and it shows you noticed how big the move is.

Books like this work best as a gift at a turning point: a new grad accepting an ICU residency, a med surg nurse transferring units, or a student who keeps talking about critical care. A preceptor might give it to an orientee, or a friend might tuck it into a care package with coffee and compression socks before their first week. It is a practical present that respects how seriously they take the work. Even a few pages read on a day off can help a new ICU nurse walk into the next shift feeling a little more prepared and a little less alone.
goodToKnow: Check the listing description and table of contents to confirm it matches their level.
Best for someone new or newly moving into ICU work rather than a seasoned critical care nurse.
Pair it with a small notebook for their own unit notes.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a new grad starting in the ICU?
faq.a: Yes, that is the kind of reader it seems aimed at. It acknowledges how big a step the ICU is and gives them something to lean on.

faq.q: Would an experienced ICU nurse want it?
faq.a: Maybe less so, since veterans already know the ropes. For them, a comfort gift usually lands better.
